cases.command:
set -e
pip install --disable-pip-version-check Django==5.2.18
python qa-gettext-app.py before
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gettext
DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=qa_gettext_settings python -m django compilemessages -l fr --verbosity 1
python qa-gettext-app.py build
